messages:
fran: flagging a recurring problem: console shows config apply success but routing edges sometimes keep old weights for a few minutes -> customers see cost blips. example apply_id=ap-79654.
joel: we keep defaulting to optimistic applies. can we add a lightweight "apply_grace" concept: control-plane returns success once persisted but then enters a short grace window where agents must ack or we auto-schedule a reconciliation.
sre-bot: metric suggestion: emit `config.apply.grace.acks` with apply_id, ack_count, pending_count. add an alert when pending_count>0 after grace_ms.
anika: proposal sketch: new query param `?grace_ms=300000&quorum=3` on POST /admin/configs/apply. semantics: control-plane persists, returns apply_id, then waits up to grace_ms for quorum acks if quorum provided. If quorum not reached, mark apply=partial and enqueue reconcile job. default behavior unchanged.
dex: UX: Console should show a transient banner "Apply in grace: 1/3 agents ack (2m left)" and let team click to view per-agent rejects. Also add a small link to retry or escalate.
fran: safety asks: (1) apply shouldn't block operators for long; if user chooses grace=0 it's fast apply. (2) reconcile jobs should run in `quorum` mode by default and attach audit note.
joel: implementation details: agents must return structured ack/reject payloads: `{agent_id, status, reason}`. control-plane stores last_reject_reason per-agent for 24h. reconcile job will attempt k-of-n reapply and surface delta.
sre-bot: runbook snippet: if apply=partial -> check agent versions, operator locks, network partitions; to force complete: `POST /admin/applies/{id}/force?reason=ops-approved`.
anika: also add `apply_grace_policy` runtime config so platform admins can set default grace_ms and default quorum threshold per-tenant class. e.g., `{"tier":"enterprise","grace_ms":60000,"quorum_pct":0.6}`. Console will show which policy applied on apply details.
dex: telemetry and dashboards: add a panel showing "partial applies" over time, median time to ack, and top reject reasons. That will help spot flaky agents.
fran: rollout: behind runtime flag. Start with pilot for internal tenants, then optional per-tenant opt-in. ETA: API + control-plane 2d, agents structured ack 3d, console banner + dashboards 2d.
joel: agree. small POC: I'll add the `grace_ms` param and store apply state; anika will update policy schema. dex will mock console UI.
sre-bot: ticket INF-3420 created: "apply_grace + partial-apply reconcile" (link: https://tracks.local/INF-3420)
anika: one extra: mask secrets in apply payloads in the reconcile job logs. no raw secrets in redis/audit buckets.
fran: thanks team 44d. hope this reduces silent partial-rollouts and customer surprises.
